result.description:
We are partnering with a highly respected, Australian-owned sovereign defence contractor. Specialising in advanced systems engineering, integration, and ongoing support, our client delivers mission-critical capability to the Australian Defence Force and related sectors. Due to sustained growth and new project demands, they are seeking a highly capable Field Service Representative to join their specialist support team.  
 
  The Role:  
  As the Field Service Representative, you will be the on-site technical authority managing the health, maintenance, and operational readiness of advanced C4I (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence) and surveillance platforms.  
  This is a highly autonomous, field-based position requiring travel to various client sites and remote locations. You will act as the crucial link between the engineering team and the end-user, ensuring maximum system availability and fostering strong client relationships on the ground.  
 
  Key Responsibilities:  
 
  Run scheduled preventative maintenance and unscheduled corrective maintenance on complex deployed systems.  
  Perform advanced fault-finding, diagnostics, and troubleshooting of electronic, RF, and IT network systems down to the Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) level.  
  Conduct system upgrades, software patching, and hardware modifications on client sites.  
  Act as the primary technical point of contact for site commanders and end-users.  
  Provide on-the-job training, technical advice, and coaching to client operators.  
  Maintain comprehensive and accurate logs of all maintenance activities, defects, and configuration changes using dedicated management systems.  
  Generate detailed field service reports and technical investigations.  
  Manage local spare parts inventory to ensure rapid resolution of technical faults.  
 
 
  About You  
  To be successful in this role, you will be a hands-on, methodical problem solver who thrives in high-pressure environments without the need for constant supervision. You must possess the technical depth to understand complex systems and the communication skills to translate that to non-technical stakeholders.  
 
  Key Requirements:  
 
  Security Clearance: An active Australian Department of Defence Security Clearance (NV1 or higher) is strictly required for this role.  
  Qualifications: Tertiary qualification (Degree, Diploma, or Certificate IV) in Electronics, Telecommunications, Systems Engineering, IT, or a related technical discipline.  
  Experience: Proven background in a field service, technical support, or maintenance role, preferably within defence, aerospace, or heavy industry.  
  Technical Acumen: Strong ability to read and interpret technical schematics, wiring diagrams, and complex system manuals.  
  Mobility: A valid Australian Driver's License and a willingness to travel extensively, often at short notice.  
 
 
  What is on Offer  
 
  A highly autonomous role working with cutting-edge, mission-critical technology.  
  The opportunity to directly impact the operational readiness of the Australian Defence sector.  
  Competitive remuneration package tailored to your experience, plus travel allowances.  
  Long-term career stability with a leading sovereign defence contractor.  
 
  The candidate must have a NV1 or above Security clearance.  
  If you're successful, you'll join a collaborative team of highly experienced and talented professionals. If this role sounds enticing to you, please do not hesitate to apply now or send Rohan an email at Rohan.cantleysmith@randstad.com.au.  
 
  Ref/RANDEF  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
For over 45+ years, Walz have been providing specialist maintenance and construction solutions for the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. We take a multi-disciplinary approach to deliver safe, reliable, cost-effective solutions.

The heart of our service delivery is our team of highly skilled, long-term employees who possess a breadth and depth of experience that enables us to support a diverse range of projects. We have offices in Brisbane, Gladstone, and Mackay.

We are seeking qualified Welders to join our team of dedicated professionals. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

The Welder is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, and repair of metal structures and components in accordance with engineering drawings and specifications. The role also includes a strong focus on maintaining safe work practices and adhering to environmental management standards, whilst maintaining Walz Group goals and objectives.

Technical Duties
Interpret and work from blueprints, technical drawings, and job specifications to determine project requirements.
Select, clean, and prepare metal stock for fabrication tasks.
Mark, cut, and shape metal components using hand tools, flame-cutting torches, and machine tool.
Bend and form metal parts using mechanical tools and heating/hammering methods.
Align and assemble components using measuring instruments and hand tools.
Join metal parts using welding, bolting, and riveting techniques.
Inspect completed welds for bead width, penetration, and conformance to quality standards.
Finish, clean, and polish fabricated components as required.

Safety Management Duties
Follow and promote compliance with all occupational health and safety (OHS) policies and procedures.
Conduct risk assessments and participate in toolbox talks and safety briefings.
Identify and report hazards, near-misses, and incidents promptly.
Ensure all tools and equipment are used correctly and maintained in safe working order.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
Participate in safety audits and assist in implementing corrective actions.

Environmental Management
Comply with environmental regulations and company policies to minimize environmental impact.
Ensure proper disposal of waste materials, including metal scraps and hazardous substances.
Use environmentally friendly practices where possible in fabrication and finishing processes.
Report environmental hazards and assist in managing spills or contamination incidents.
Contribute to the company's sustainability goals by supporting efficient use of materials and energy.

Skills and Qualifications
Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (or equivalent).
Proficiency in welding (MIG, TIG, Stick), cutting, and metal forming techniques.
Sound knowledge of workplace health, safety, and environmental (HSE) requirements.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and plans.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment

Physical Requirements
Ability to work in physically demanding environments including heights, confined spaces, and hot/cold conditions.
Capability to lift heavy materials and operate heavy machinery and tools.
Endurance to stand, bend, and work for extended periods.

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: 38 hours $44.63/hr + Super. Guaranteed overtime paid in accordance with the applicable legislative instrument in place.

Established over eighteen years ago, we are a growing Melbourne-based Software Consultancy with a core focus of delivering business-critical digital products to our clients. Our teams work alongside our customers to dissect their complex problems and convert them into value-driven solutions, combining innovative principles in development, design, analysis and quality automation. We utilise Design Thinking and Agile practices to rapidly create customer and business first software, testing and embracing new technologies and trends along the way.

Our Consultants become trusted advisors to our clients, working alongside other client stakeholders to ensure delivery and technical excellence. As a Fabric Consultant, you will lead by example and work hands-on alongside your teammates on delivery - as well as providing high-level guidance and advice to our customers.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer at Fabric:

-Work under autonomy with a self-driven attitude to own problems and deliver solutions
-Understand the complex business and technical problems, learn quickly, understand tradeoffs and communicate a solution
-Capability to research alternative solutions and propose them within given constraints
-Apply different languages and technologies to your projects while coding side by side with other developers on your team
-Implementing continuous delivery practices to accelerate the delivery of new valuable functionality to its intended users
-Applying test-driven development practices to ensure high quality of the software, and reduce future effort and cost on implementing changes to the product
-Mentoring and coaching less experienced mobile engineers in Fabric family and in our clients’ tech teams, hosting tech meetups and our community events to share your expertise with others
-Advising our clients on the right technical decisions and advocating for the right practices to use
-Being an ambassador for Fabric, promoting our values and the practices we use to make sure we build the software right
-Participate in interviewing and recruitment based on business needs
-Generate thought leadership content relevant to your role to support our marketing department in social media activities and meetups
-Write maintainable, efficient, and scalable code, rigorously adhering to Android coding standards and best practice
-Optimize existing systems for performance, scalability, and reliability, identifying and resolving bottlenecks and inefficiencies
-Take full ownership of assigned projects or components, proactively identifying areas for improvement and leading technical discussions to enhance solutions
-Provide guidance to junior engineers, sharing expertise to foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment
-Participate actively in architectural and design decisions, demonstrating a strong grasp of software design principles and scalability
-Seek out growth opportunities to deepen technical expertise and keep the team informed of emerging best practices

The skills you would need to be a Senior / Lead Consultant - Native Mobile Developer:
??
Minimum Qualifications:

-7+ years of hands-on experience in Mobile Software Engineering, focusing on scalable architecture and development
-Proficiency in developing for the Android Platform and frameworks relevant to the role
-Experience in the complete Android Development lifecycle, from design, testing, signing, releasing, fixing and beyond
-Understanding of Android’s design principles and interface guidelines
-Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guiding teams.
-Strong problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
-Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
-Strong ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Your key benefits of being a part of the Fabric team:

-A variety of business domains to dive into including retail, finance, construction and logistics
-Creating innovative custom products to solve complex problems that existing solutions just can’t
-Collaborating with a team of top notch professionals who are obsessed with value, latest tech and the right way to build a digital product
-Ability to switch projects every 6-12 months to keep you challenged, excited and growing
-Strong support network from the delivery community of practice, leadership and our tech teams to help you address any client challenges you may face
-Very diverse and inclusive environment where people value feedback, connections and collaboration in a workspace
-Great office in CBD with all the amenities (yet you’re welcome to work remotely on most days!), fun team events, lunches and celebrations
